change_class_vocabulary.semantics: Categories are category:* tags on Pants owners. Legacy classes remain as historical route detail; the retired selectorless floor is deliberately not a change category.

method.collector: uv run python scripts/pants_ci_benchmark.py sample --change-class CLASS --phase PHASE -- COMMAND
method.notes: Five samples permit explicitly provisional percentiles; ten are required before the result is labeled measured. Singleton lifecycle observations never receive percentile labels.

comparison.interpretation: The old end-to-end route was necessarily slower than its directly observed 287.42s native component. The new directly observed p90 is 30.891s, so 89.25% is a conservative measured lower bound, not a Pants-only cache comparison.
